name: Beginnings and Promises Quiz Bank
summary: Reusable quiz questions from the Beginnings and Promises lesson pack.

questions.question: Who made the heavens and the earth?
This lesson teaches that god made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation.
Why should we treat people with respect?
questions.answer: People are made in God's image

questions.question: This lesson teaches that every person has value because God made people in His image.
What happened when Adam and Eve disobeyed God?
This lesson teaches that sin breaks trust with God, but God still seeks and cares for people.
What did God warn Cain about?
questions.answer: Sin was crouching at the door

questions.question: This lesson teaches that anger must be brought to God before it grows into sin.
What did God tell Noah to build?
The rainbow reminded Noah that God keeps His ____.
Why did the people build the tower?
questions.answer: To make a name for themselves

questions.question: This lesson teaches that pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation.
What did Abram do when God called him?
questions.answer: He went as God told him

questions.question: This lesson teaches that faith means following God even when we do not know every next step.
Who chose land first?
This lesson teaches that peace sometimes means letting go instead of grabbing first place.
What did God show Abram?
This lesson teaches that god keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us.
What was Abraham and Sarah's son named?
This lesson teaches that god's timing can be surprising, but His promises do not fail.
What did God provide instead?
This lesson teaches that god provides and calls His people to trust Him deeply.
What did Esau trade away?
This lesson teaches that quick wants can lead to foolish choices when we forget what matters most.
What new name was Jacob given?
This lesson teaches that god can change people and give them a new way to walk.
Who became angry about Joseph's dreams?
This lesson teaches that god can be at work even when family life is messy and painful.
What did Joseph choose instead of revenge?
This lesson teaches that forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge.
